title: SR-1.25 A cloud seat allowed to assign tasks addresses one local seat, never all
request: Closes G90: with bus.cloud_tasks on, a cloud seat's task to all is accepted (src/engine/bus.mjs:307 checks the type, not the address), while docs/BUS.md:100-101 grants a task to a local seat and nothing else. Found by the memev twin on 30 October 2026 at main be457db (a sealed run in the twin's evidence). Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: QL-1.02. Sensitive path (the oplog): the QL-1.03 checklist applies before merge.

tasks.title: Address checked with the type
requirements: a cloud seat's task is accepted only when it is addressed to one named local seat; all, a cloud seat and an unknown seat are refused with the reason
the address is checked before anything is written: a refused cloud send leaves the bus log, its size and every seat's unread unchanged

a seat is a cloud seat when its device's current kind in the registry is cloud-connector, whatever its name, number suffix, sub-seat or rename; a seat on an enrolled remote computer (the owner's own device) is a local seat; a removed seat or a seat whose computer was revoked is refused
a cloud seat's task 'to' must be a string naming one registered local seat exactly; an array, any other type, 'all' in any case or with padding, and a name with a control character are refused

with cloud_tasks on, the refusal for 'all' or a cloud seat says a cloud task goes to one local seat and does not mention turning cloud_tasks on; an unknown seat is refused with code not_found and 'no seat <name>'
a caller that is not local and has no device record is treated as a cloud seat
when the lead is a cloud seat, a cloud seat's task to the operator alias is refused like a task to that seat by name
memev doctor flags cloud tasks to 'all' or to a cloud seat that are already in the bus logs from before this change
docs/BUS.md says a cloud task goes to one named local seat, that a seat on an enrolled remote computer counts as local, and that 'all', a cloud seat and an unknown seat are refused

each red-green criterion of this task that runs test/bus-cloud-address.test.mjs has its own subtest whose name starts with <task>-cNN: (NN is the criterion's position in this task, so T1-c01: for the first), and the criterion runs only that subtest
